title: Three Essential Pieces of Advice
summary: The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) advises on piety, good deeds, and noble character.
translation: In this hadith, the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) gives three pieces of advice. The first advice, narrated by Hazrat Mu'adh and Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA), is "Fear Allah wherever you are." The second is "Follow up a bad deed with a good one, for it will erase it." The third advice is "Treat people with good character." These three pieces of advice are essential for a successful life. The first is to maintain consciousness of Allah, both outwardly and inwardly, as also advised to Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) with the words "I advise you to adopt piety in both your private and public life." The words are concise yet comprehensive, including avoiding prohibited matters according to Shariah. The second advice derives from the Quranic verse that states good deeds remove bad deeds, with scholars interpreting it to mean all types of good deeds removing minor sins if one is regretful and determined not to repeat them. Without repentance, sins remain. The third significant point emphasizes excellent manners towards others, with several hadiths mentioning that the best among people are those with the best character. On the Day of Judgment, the heaviest deeds in a believer’s scale will be good character.
